Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1425
Claimant:
Kyle Williams
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
May 12, 2023
Claim received for a side impact at an intersection involving our insured vehicle. The claimant is represented by
counsel, so all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
May 20, 2023
Reviewed the police report and statements from two witnesses, who both describe the collision as occurring just as
the claimant reported it. The other driver also confirms the sequence of events, and the claimant's account has
matched across every conversation so far.
July 10, 2023
Photos of the vehicle show damage consistent with the described impact angle and force. A few older scratches are
visible, though they may predate this crash and are being noted separately.
September 26, 2023
Confirmed through the police record and witness accounts that the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the
collision. The driver is listed by name on the policy, and nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before
coverage began.
October 1, 2023
The reported whiplash is a plausible injury for a collision of this type. Medical records show no prior injury to the same
area of the body. Treatment followed a typical course and tapered off as the claimant improved.
December 5, 2023
Reviewed the full file with the claim supervisor. Liability and vehicle damage align with the reported facts, and the
injury claim is proceeding through standard evaluation with counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
